## [0.16.0](https://github.com/asyncapi/parser-js/compare/v0.15.0...v0.16.0) (2020-03-23)


> **NOTICE**:
Instead of `asyncapi-parser` we now release to NPM under `@asyncapi` scope, so the package you should now use in your dependencies is `@asyncapi/parser`

### Features

* add configuration for automated releases ([#53](https://github.com/asyncapi/parser-js/issues/53)) ([617bd02](https://github.com/asyncapi/parser-js/commit/617bd02368552afed55f22b0a3b59b8ca4a7ddbb))


### Bug Fixes

* bring back dist dir to fix bundle script ([#54](https://github.com/asyncapi/parser-js/issues/54)) ([eba0859](https://github.com/asyncapi/parser-js/commit/eba0859bf7be17d3ec61766641116a16322a87db))

Changes in this release:

* Added the "Sponsor" button on Github ❤️ 
* Added GitHub Actions-powered stale bot and a welcome message for new contributors 👋 
* Extract RAML and OpenAPI schema parsers to their own package 💪

We added two new methods: `Channel#hasParameters()` and `Server#hasVariables()`. Read more [here](github.com/asyncapi/parser-js/issues/38).

Also, we're happy to announce that we now support RAML data types as message payloads. Read more [here](github.com/asyncapi/parser-js/issues/34).

We switched from `openapi-schema-to-json-schema dependency` to `@openapi-contrib/openapi-schema-to-json-schema dependency` because the former is deprecated. Know more [here](github.com/asyncapi/parser-js/issues/37).
